_source: Master Field Register v1.0, Master Specialty Register v1.0, Master Alias Register v1.0 (Active Longevity Institute, September 2026). Supersedes v0.2/v0.1. Regenerated from the documents; edit the documents, not this file.

descriptors.Actuarial Science: For actuarial work applying quantitative methods to risk, uncertainty, insurance, pensions and related financial questions.
descriptors.Aging Biology: For biological research focused specifically on the mechanisms, processes and consequences of biological aging.
descriptors.Architecture & Urban Design: For professional and scholarly work focused on the design of buildings, places and the physical form of communities.
descriptors.Artificial Intelligence: For work specifically focused on the development, study or technical advancement of artificial intelligence and machine-learning systems.
descriptors.Bioinformatics: For computational work focused on the analysis and interpretation of biological and biomedical data.
descriptors.Biology: For work broadly centered on living organisms, biological processes and biological systems.
descriptors.Biostatistics: For statistical work specifically applied to health, medicine, biology and related life sciences.
descriptors.Business & Management: For work concerned broadly with the leadership, management, strategy and operation of organizations.
descriptors.Computer Science: For work grounded in computing, including algorithms, software, computational systems and the theory of computation.
descriptors.Dietetics: For the professional practice of applying nutrition knowledge to the dietary care and guidance of individuals and populations.
descriptors.Finance: For work concerned broadly with financial systems, institutions, markets, corporate finance and the management of financial resources.
descriptors.Financial Planning: For professional work helping individuals or households plan and manage their personal financial lives.
descriptors.Gerontology: For interdisciplinary work focused broadly on aging, later life and the experience of growing older.
descriptors.Health Administration & Management: For work focused on the leadership, management and operation of healthcare organizations and health services.
descriptors.Health Policy: For work focused on the development, analysis or evaluation of policies affecting health and healthcare.
descriptors.Housing: For work focused on housing systems, provision, development, management, affordability and access to housing.
descriptors.Human Resources: For professional work focused on managing and supporting people within organizations, including talent, workforce development and the employee experience.
descriptors.Insurance: For work within insurance and reinsurance, including underwriting, products, claims, operations and regulation.
descriptors.Investment Management: For professional work focused on managing investments, portfolios and investment strategies.
descriptors.Nutrition Science: For scientific work focused on nutrition, nutrients, diet and their relationships with health and human biology.
descriptors.Organizational Behavior: For work focused on how individuals, groups and organizational systems behave within workplaces and organizations.
descriptors.Pensions & Retirement Benefits: For work focused on pension systems, retirement benefits and the provision of income in retirement.
descriptors.Public Administration: For work focused on the administration, management and functioning of government and public institutions.
descriptors.Public Health: For work focused on the health of populations, including prevention, health promotion and population-level health outcomes.
descriptors.Public Policy: For work focused broadly on the development, analysis or evaluation of government and public policies across policy areas.
descriptors.Social Care: For work focused on the provision, organization or study of care and support services for people who need assistance in daily life.
descriptors.Social Work: For the professional discipline and practice of social work and the work of social work practitioners.
descriptors.Statistics: For work centered on statistical theory, methods, analysis and inference across areas of application.
descriptors.Technology: For professional work centered on the development, implementation or strategic use of technology that is not more accurately represented by a more specific Field.
